notice:
The HSK 3.0 characters are the official character list (HSK 汉字大纲, the characters to recognise, 认读字, of each level) of the 《HSK 考试大纲》 Syllabus for the Chinese Proficiency Test, edition published 2025-11 and effective 2026-07. A character's level is the level whose list introduces it; the syllabus's lists of characters to write (书写字) assign no level here.

Source: [www.chinesetest.cn](https://www.chinesetest.cn) — reproduced from the Chinese Test Service Website (CTI); syllabus published by CLEC (中外语言交流合作中心). No reuse licence is granted: the site's [Legal Notice](https://www.chinesetest.cn/legal-notice) says its content is copyrighted by CTI or the content providers, requires the source to be indicated, and permits reproduction only as reasonable, good-faith quoting for informative public use. The syllabus PDF carries a copy-protection flag. The project includes only the vocabulary (word) list and the list of characters to recognise, as plain lists of words and characters with their levels (and the words' pinyin as lookup readings), and none of the syllabus's other content (grammar points, descriptions, the lists of characters to write, explanatory text). It includes these lists with this attribution at the project owner's decision; the legal status of including these lists has not been verified.
